name: D4RL: Datasets for Deep Data-Driven Reinforcement Learning
description: D4RL is the standard benchmark suite for offline (data-driven) reinforcement learning. Curated by UC Berkeley, Stanford, and Google Research, it provides standardized offline datasets across continuous control environments including OpenAI Gym MuJoCo robotics tasks, AntMaze navigation, dexterous hand manipulation (Adroit), Franka Kitchen manipulation, and CARLA autonomous driving, establishing reproducible evaluation protocols without online environment interaction.
